route: Niederlassungsbewilligung 'ausgenommen Erwerbstaetigkeit' (para 44 NAG): 'Drittstaatsangehoerigen kann eine Niederlassungsbewilligung - ausgenommen Erwerbstaetigkeit erteilt werden, wenn ... ein Quotenplatz vorhanden ist und ... deren feste und regelmaessige monatliche Einkuenfte der Hoehe nach dem Zweifachen der Richtsaetze des para 293 ASVG entsprechen.' Para 11 (2) no. 3 NAG: 'der Fremde ueber einen alle Risken abdeckenden Krankenversicherungsschutz verfuegt und diese Versicherung in Oesterreich auch leistungspflichtig ist'.
policy: OeGK Selbstversicherung in der Krankenversicherung (ASVG): open to people not otherwise insured with residence in Austria. Fixed 565.25 EUR per person per month in 2026 (not income-based; reduction can be requested). Benefits in kind (doctor, hospital, medicines); no sick pay. Six-month waiting period before benefits in kind unless previously insured. One spouse is co-insured.
working: One full ÖGK contribution of €565.25 plus a spouse supplement of 3.4% × €7,486.80 = €254.55. Assumes no child-rearing or care exemption.

eu_citizen_difference: EU citizens with a right of residence are not subject to the NAG quota and can often use EHIC/S1 or free-movement rules; a non-EU couple needs a quota place and cover that covers all risks and is payable in Austria.
spot_check: No independent figure. A private Austrian full policy was not priced because no insurer publishes a tariff. A Selbstversicherung student rate (78.84) and marginal-employment rate (83.49) appear on the same pages, confirming the 565.25 is the general rate, not a reduced one.
uncertainty: Quota places for para 44 are scarce and set yearly by decree (not researched). The twice-Richtsatz income figure for 2026 was not retrieved. Whether the OeGK accepts a newcomer on a first permit for Selbstversicherung, and whether a private policy would satisfy the authority at a lower price, was not confirmed. Reduction of the contribution is possible on application.

statutory_must_pay.what: One full ÖGK contribution of €565.25 plus a spouse supplement of 3.4% × €7,486.80 = €254.55. Assumes no child-rearing or care exemption.

private_plan.insurer: Austrian private insurers (comparison-site table, no insurer named)
private_plan.terms: Hospital: Sonderklasse (private ward, free choice of doctor) without deductible; out-patient: private-doctor tariff. Waiting periods and health questions apply, not stated by the source.
private_plan.pricing: Source gives monthly ranges by age: age 40 Komfort 110-150, Privatarzt 35-85; age 50 Komfort 150-200, Privatarzt 50-120. Age 45 is the interpolated midpoint: Komfort 152.50 + Privatarzt 72.50 = 225 EUR each, x2 = 450. Interpolation is the agent's, not the source's. Source says the figures are indicative guides from public insurer information (20 April 2026).
